title: Prove the whole PythonConstraint experiment
outcome: Produce one reproducible, evidence-bearing PythonConstraint experiment that maps the owner-selected Vero task into DomainSpec-v2, runs the complete declared proof path, preserves exact inputs and results, and states what the experiment supports and does not support about the CyberAlchemy product thesis.
rationale: The experiment is a bounded way to test whether connected intent, meaning, evidence, ownership, and validation can improve the continuity and honesty of agentic engineering work.
scope: the Vero PythonConstraint target at commit 0a7325df9e9e6dbc275c0ad483b3d1cbe38d9b09
DomainSpec-v2 intent, obligation, and implementation mapping
a reproducible local runtime and complete declared validation path
result evidence and a claim-bounded product assessment
exclusions: claims that one experiment proves productivity or product-market fit
implicit authority to modify unrelated DomainSpec-v2 or CyberAlchemy-v2 work
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus DomainSpec v2 experiment owner

success_conditions.statement: The selected benchmark, source revision, proof inventory, and licenses are exact and reproducible.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Pinned revisions, source digests, proof inventory, license records, and a passing admission check.

success_conditions.statement: The PythonConstraint task is represented in DomainSpec-v2 with explicit concepts, relations, obligations, ownership, and claim limits.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: A validator-safe DomainSpec-v2 package and mapping receipt covering the selected task.

success_conditions.statement: The complete declared experiment runs in the pinned local container and preserves exact run inputs and outputs.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Container provenance, commands, exit statuses, logs, artifacts, and two-run determinism or an explicit nondeterminism finding.

success_conditions.statement: Every declared validator and proof check reaches a terminal result, with blocked checks reported as not evaluable instead of passed.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Aggregate validation receipt with the complete check set and causal blockers.

success_conditions.statement: The final assessment connects observed experiment evidence to the CyberAlchemy product thesis without inflating one run into general product proof.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: A claim map that separates observed evidence, inference, counterevidence, product-thesis support, and remaining residue.

evidence_requirements: Evidence must identify its source, exact revision or digest, producing command or method, observed result, owner, and claim limit.
Achievement requires evidence for all five success conditions and an owner-recorded lifecycle change.
Missing or blocked evidence remains visible and cannot be counted as a pass.

evidence_refs.claim_limit: Supports target selection and pinned source identity only.

revision_history.change: Created the first Project-linked Goal and bound it to the CyberAlchemy product thesis before continuing the experiment.

challenge_route: Challenge outcome meaning or thesis fit through the CyberAlchemy v2 product owner; challenge mapping or proof evidence through the DomainSpec v2 experiment owner.
